description.value:
You touch a creature with a jolt of static energy, making a melee tech attack against it. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 lightning damage; however, if it is a living creature currently at 0 hit points, it instead gains a success on a death saving throw rather than taking damage.

The damage increases to 2d10 at 5th level, 3d10 at 11th level, and 4d10 at 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
